### How to Use This Template

1. Copy this template
2. Fill in the [DATE] with the week's date range
3. Update all sections
4. Either:
   - Add to PROGRESS.md under a "Weekly Updates" section
   - Create a separate file: `docs/updates/2026-W14.md`
   - Post as a GitHub Discussion
5. Commit with message: `docs: weekly update [date]`
